actions-cool GitHub Actions tags rewritten by TeamPCP

Target: actions-cool · repo
Date: 2026-05-18 to 2026-09-25 (130 days)
Actor: TeamPCP (group)
Target Kind: organization
Language: JavaScript
Cause: compromised_repository_access
Motive: credential_theft
Transitive: true
Impact: credential_theft, data_exfiltration
User Impact: 3000
Phase: ci_cd
Campaigns: Shai-Hulud hits npm and PyPI

Synopsis

Attackers rewrote version tags for two actions-cool GitHub Actions to run secret-stealing code. GitHub disabled the repositories in May, but the same malicious tags became available again in September.

Story

On May 18, 2026, attackers redirected version tags for actions-cool/issues-helper and actions-cool/maintain-one-comment to malicious commits. Consumers pinned to affected tags received the injected action on their next workflow run.

The injected step downloaded Bun and read the GitHub Actions Runner.Worker process memory to extract workflow secrets. It sent captured credentials to t.m-kosche.com. The operation overlapped with other compromises attributed to TeamPCP.

GitHub disabled both repositories. They became available again with the malicious tags on September 16, then were disabled again on September 25. The September activity renewed distribution of the May compromise; it does not establish a second initial intrusion.
